skill.note: Only rules stated by the source skill may be treated as permanent skill constraints. An unobserved rule is not removable.

tasks.text: 请按所加载的 law-to-markdown skill 处理工作目录中的 document.txt。自行判断文档类型，不得修改输入文件；如 skill 提供 bundled script，直接从 runtime-resource-root 调用。按 minimal 产物级别写入 markdown/document/，审核通过时生成 document+审核报告.md 和 document+最终成果.md。最终成果保持原文字符流，只增加规定的 Markdown 标题、规范空白并拆分项/目。禁止联网或安装依赖。完成后简要列出产物。
tasks.note: Current task values and restrictions are task-scoped unless the source skill independently states them.

environments.note: Observed runtime facts describe this execution and are not portable skill requirements by default.

unknown.note: If the available source cannot establish a constraint's scope, record scope=unknown; do not promote it to a permanent rule or discard it.
